requirements.description: Annual Compustat combined industrial fundamentals used for the 1988–2000 industry-year accrual fits, the 1993–2000 primary firm-year model, the five-change smoothing measure, industry-year ranks, and the primary availability/outlier screens. Required concepts include fiscal-year identifiers and SIC, basic EPS excluding extraordinary items, net income, operating cash flows, total assets, sales, gross PPE, split adjustment, shares and price/market value fields used in screening.

required_coverage.population: The 2004 Compustat combined industrial annual population used by Tucker and Zarowin, with financial and regulated SICs 4000–4999 and 6000–6999 excluded from the primary sample; the support-fit paragraph does not separately restate the filter, and exact retained industry-year population is not reported.
required_coverage.detail: Offset arithmetic: baseline labels t=1993–2000. Five changes at t−4,…,t require DAP/PDI levels from t−5,…,t, so the earliest DAP year is 1988. The 1988 accrual fit uses Assets_{t−1} and ΔSales_{t−1}, requiring raw 1987 Assets/Sales. Support fits run 1988–2000. Baseline cleaning uses earnings/CFO/accruals at t−3 through t+3 (1990–2003); future EPS X_{t3} also reaches 2003. Union: fiscal-year labels 1987–2003. The 2004 source vintage is specified; local current-vintage coverage/population is unconfirmed.

routes.mapping_notes: The exact live fields and catalog labels are present. Labels semantically match many source concepts (for example epspx is Basic EPS excluding Extraordinary Items; oancf is Operating Activities - Net Cash Flow; ppegt is gross PPE; fyear/datadate/fyr distinguish fiscal labels from actual dates). Mapping the paper’s 2004 combined-industrial vintage and legacy Data item codes to the present extract, exact EPS stock-split/dividend adjustment handling, and the original product filters/population still require confirmation. Do not infer those from numeric/name resemblance or a sampled row.
routes.coverage_notes: The shared preferred probe verified access and live columns in one bounded row; coverage_verified is false. It does not establish 1987–2003 historical coverage, the 2004 vintage, or the required firm/industry population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the required 1987–2003 annual history and target population in the local current-vintage COMP.FUNDA file. The 2004 combined-industrial vintage and exact historical item/adjustment/product-filter mappings also remain unverified.

requirements.description: Daily equity prices, returns, and shares needed for fiscal-year ex-dividend returns, future three-year compounded returns, beginning-of-fiscal-year EPS price deflators, and beginning-year market-equity denominators in sample screening.

required_coverage.frequency: daily security observations aligned to firm fiscal-year dates
required_coverage.population: CRSP securities linked to the study’s Compustat combined-industrial firms over primary sample years 1993–2000 and their past/current/future-three-year financial screening windows; security class and exact retained population are not fully specified.
required_coverage.detail: Conservative calendar-year envelope: primary firm-year labels 1993–2000, sample screens extend through t−3=1990 and t+3=2003; beginning-of-year market equity/price can require the prior calendar year, and actual fiscal-year dates are to be aligned from Compustat datadate/fyr, potentially reaching the following calendar year. The paper does not specify the exact daily return aggregation or fiscal-year price convention; 1989–2004 is a conservative date envelope, not proof of coverage.

routes.mapping_notes: The exact live fields and catalog labels are present: RETX is Returns without Dividends, PRC is Price or Bid/Ask Average, CFACPR is the cumulative price factor, SHROUT is shares outstanding, and PERMNO/DATE identify security observations. RETX is a plausible source for “ex-dividend” return, but the paper does not name CRSP, a field, return aggregation, fiscal-year endpoint convention, or beginning-price date; mapping those measures is therefore unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: The shared preferred DSF probe establishes a successful bounded read and exact columns only. It has no coordinator coverage confirmation for the required history, linked population, or date-frequency alignment.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local CRSP.DSF access/fields are verified, but no supplied confirmation establishes 1989–2004 daily coverage for the target population. The paper leaves the source, daily return aggregation, exact fiscal-year return boundaries, and beginning-year price convention unresolved; RETX is only a plausible semantic candidate.

requirements.description: Date-valid Compustat GVKEY to CRSP PERMNO/PERMCO links for merging annual accounting observations to CRSP daily security prices and returns; link selection and valid date overlap must support the target firms and historical period.

required_coverage.population: The Compustat primary and accrual-fit firms that require CRSP daily observations for 1989–2004; exact security class and link-selection population are not reported.
required_coverage.detail: Link intervals must cover CRSP observation dates supporting current/future returns and beginning-year prices/market equity for the 1993–2000 primary sample, including past/current/future-three-year sample screens. Use linkdt/linkenddt and source-compatible primary/type/use rules; the paper does not specify a linking table or selection rule. Coverage is unresolved.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels identify GVKEY, historical CRSP PERMNO/PERMCO links, link type/primary/use markers, and first/last effective dates. These are plausible fields for a dated crosswalk, but the paper does not identify this table or report link selection criteria; no evidence verifies historical validity for the sample or links to the exact Compustat vintage.
routes.coverage_notes: The shared preferred probe verifies access and field presence in one bounded row; coverage_verified is false and no sample-wide GVKEY–PERMNO link coverage is confirmed.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation supports valid GVKEY–PERMNO links over the required security-date window and population. Source-specific link table, primary/type/use selection, and exact fiscal-year join rules are not reported.

variable_coverage.construction: Total accruals = (income before extraordinary items and discontinued operations − operating cash flows) / beginning-year Assets_{t−1}; estimated cross-sectionally by two-digit SIC and fiscal year, with the fit residual producing DAP.
Inverse beginning-year total assets, 1/Assets_{t−1}, in the supporting accrual fit.
Change in net sales from t−1 to t divided by beginning-year Assets_{t−1}.
Gross PPE at fiscal-year t end divided by beginning-year Assets_{t−1}.
Net income in fiscal year t divided by beginning-year Assets_{t−1} (ROA).

Ex-dividend annual return during fiscal year t. CRSP daily RETX is a plausible candidate, to be aggregated over fiscal-year dates using the GVKEY–PERMNO link; exact source/aggregation/date convention is not specified.

Basic EPS excluding extraordinary items for fiscal year t−1 divided by stock price at the beginning of fiscal year t; use current Compustat EPS and a date-aligned CRSP price, subject to confirming the split/dividend adjustment.

Basic EPS excluding extraordinary items for fiscal year t divided by stock price at the beginning of fiscal year t; use current Compustat EPS and a date-aligned CRSP price, subject to confirming the split/dividend adjustment.
Sum of basic EPS excluding extraordinary items for t+1 through t+3 divided by stock price at the beginning of fiscal year t; Compustat future EPS and a date-aligned CRSP price.
Annually compounded stock return over fiscal years t+1 through t+3, constructed from CRSP security returns and date-valid GVKEY–PERMNO links; exact source/formula/date boundaries remain unspecified.

Within two-digit-SIC-by-fiscal-year reversed fractional rank of Pearson Corr(ΔDAP, ΔPDI) over five annual changes (t and prior four years). DAP is the residual of the required modified Jones/ROA support fit; PDI=NI−DAP; DAP and PDI are asset-deflated.
IS_t multiplied by X_{t−1}; combines the five-change DAP/PDI construction with lagged basic EPS and beginning-of-fiscal-year stock price.
IS_t multiplied by X_t; combines the five-change DAP/PDI construction with current basic EPS and beginning-of-fiscal-year stock price.
IS_t multiplied by X_{t3}; combines the five-change DAP/PDI construction with the sum of EPS in t+1 through t+3 and beginning-of-fiscal-year stock price.
IS_t multiplied by R_{t3}; combines the five-change DAP/PDI construction with the annually compounded CRSP return in fiscal years t+1 through t+3.

design_coverage.reason: No standard-error or clustering correction is reported; the article reports t-statistics but does not identify a cluster dimension.

The primary regression is described as pooled cross-sectional/time-series data; the support model is estimated by two-digit-SIC-by-fiscal-year cross-sections. Underlying estimators are not named; fiscal-year and SIC inputs are required for grouping.
Regression (4) is pooled and does not report fixed effects. IS and support fits use two-digit-SIC-by-fiscal-year ranks/groups; SIC and fiscal-year fields are needed for those constructions.
Compustat GVKEY must be linked to CRSP PERMNO over valid security dates; link field presence is proven but sample-period link coverage and selection rules are not.
Reproduce missing-input deletion, top/bottom 1 percent trims, ±10 market-equity screens, future-return bounds, and annual three-standard-deviation winsorization of support-fit regression variables.

The primary sample is firm-years 1993–2000 with SIC, missingness, trimming, ±10 market-equity and future-return screens; Compustat accounting and CRSP market inputs are required. The support-fit sector population is not separately restated.
No weights are specified for Regression (4) or the supporting accrual fits.

implementation_issues.description: Regression (4) is described as pooled cross-sectional/time-series data, but the underlying estimator and standard-error/clustering procedure are not identified. The supporting cross-sectional accrual estimator is also not named. These are essential reconstruction specifications.

R_t is defined as an ex-dividend stock return for fiscal year t and R_t3 as annual compounded returns in t+1…t+3, but the source does not name the return product/field, exact date interval, return aggregation or beginning-year price convention. CRSP RETX is a plausible candidate, not a verified mapping.

The source gives annual sample labels and a Compustat data vintage, while CRSP uses calendar-dated observations. Use Compustat fyear as the fiscal-year label and datadate/fyr to align CRSP dates; do not substitute filing dates. The exact fiscal-year return endpoints are not stated.

The five-change IS measure at t uses DAP/PDI levels t−5…t. The first primary year (1993) therefore needs DAP from 1988; the 1988 supporting fit’s lagged Assets and prior Sales require raw 1987 accounting data. The source’s stated fit cutoff of 1988 is not the earliest raw predictor year.

The study-level data paragraph excludes financial/regulated SIC 4000–4999 and 6000–6999, while the separate accrual-fit paragraph does not restate whether those sectors are excluded from all 1988–2000 fits. Exact fit population and per-fit Ns remain unspecified.

The primary EPS definition requires split/dividend adjustment and the support/sample inputs refer to legacy Compustat item numbers. Current field labels are plausible matches, but exact mapping and current-vintage treatment must be confirmed before construction.

The study uses the 2004 Compustat combined-industrial annual vintage; the available local COMP.FUNDA probe is a current-vintage file and does not establish historical vintage equivalence or reproduction of the reported sample size.

The source specifies three-standard-deviation winsorization of support-fit regressors each year and primary percentile/extreme screens, but does not fully detail operation order, tie handling, or boundary handling for the reversed fractional IS ranks.

review_notes: The work item’s model formulas agree with the source’s verified Regression (1) and Regression (4) transcriptions. The source specifies PDI=NI−DAP and that both PDI and DAP are beginning-assets deflated; this is retained as construction, not treated as a raw vendor field.

The source’s primary sample period is fiscal-year labels 1993–2000. Its accrual-fit years are 1988–2000, but lagged Assets and ΔSales at the first fit year require raw 1987 records. The first IS at 1993 requires six DAP/PDI levels (1988–1993), not only five levels.

The article excludes SIC 4000–4999 and 6000–6999 for the study-level data; the support-fit paragraph reports two-digit-SIC/year fits and 650 retained cross-sections but does not independently restate that exclusion. The support population remains unresolved.

Local COMP.FUNDA, CRSP.DSF and CCM link-table access/field presence are supported only by the exact preferred one-row probes. No local coverage confirmations were supplied; none of these sampled files is treated as historically or population-complete.

Use current-vintage local sources only as candidate routes with vintage differences noted. Historical Compustat numeric item codes were not mapped by numeric/name resemblance; exact vintage/product mapping and EPS split-adjustment handling remain open.
